title: Tín hiệu cơ bản (1)
vision_description: The lecture page titled 'Tín hiệu cơ bản (1)' presents basic signal concepts with text, formulas, and diagrams. It includes descriptions of unit step, unit impulse (Dirac delta function), and unit ramp signals.
main_message: Introduction to basic signals: unit step, unit impulse, and unit ramp.
definitions: Unit Step Signal: A signal that is 1 for t ≥ 0 and 0 for t < 0.
Unit Impulse Signal: Also known as the Dirac delta function, it is 0 for all t ≠ 0 and undefined at t = 0.
Unit Ramp Signal: A signal with a constant slope starting from the origin.
formulas: Unit Impulse: δ(t) = 0 ∀ t ≠ 0; undefined at t = 0
